M/S. Cooperative Milk Producet Union ... vs State Of Jk And Anr
on 23 February, 2024
Author: Wasim Sadiq Nargal 
Bench: Wasim Sadiq Nargal
 S. No. 17
 Regular list
 In The High C0Urt 0F Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 Owp No. 900/2016
M/S. Cooperative Milk Producet Union Ltd. ...Petitioner(s)
Through: Mr. Mir Riyaz, Adv.
 Vs.
State of Jk and Anr. ...Respondent(s) 
Through: None
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge
 Order
23.02.2024 The report of the Registry reveals that the Registry has issued a chain of dockets/notices to the office of Additional Deputy Commissioner, Anantnag for summoning the record of case titled Food Safety Officer Qazigund Vs. Mohammad Jabar Mir and Ors. However, the same has not been received and consequently, the matter could not be argued today. 
In the aforesaid backdrop, Registry is directed to seek report at the first instance from the office of Additional Deputy Commissioner, Anantnag, as to why the record as summoned by this Court has not been send to the Registry of this Court. 
Let the aforesaid report be submitted before this Court within a period of one week. 
List again on 13th March, 2024. 
In the meantime, send for the record from the office of Additional Deputy Commissioner, Anantnag. 
It is made clear that in case the needful is not done within the aforesaid period, the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Anantnag, shall appear in person before this Court on the next date of hearing.
